review_candidates.description: Your Job As an Assistant Construction Manager with DEPCOM Power, you will support field execution across utility-scale solar and energy storage projects by partnering with Construction Managers and project teams to drive safe, high-quality project delivery. You will help coordinate Civil, Mechanical, and Electrical construction activities, support development of field leadership teams, and contribute to consistent processes that keep projects aligned with safety, quality, schedule, and budget objectives. Through collaboration with subcontractors, customers, and internal stakeholders, you will help ensure successful project execution while building the capabilities needed for future leadership opportunities. Current Project Site Opportunities Potential Locations: East Dublin, Georgia Location subject to change based on business needs. Travel Requirements: This is a full-time, site-based position that includes daily per diem and home rotations approximately every 3-4 weeks. Compensation : $110,000 - $140,000 (flexible based on experience) Our Team DEPCOM's Project Delivery Organization executes full turnkey PV and BESS plants with collection substations and generation transmission lines. We utilize preferred partnerships with key vendors and subcontractors while coordinating with interconnection utilities across the nation. As a Koch Company, we implement Principle Based Management to continue driving innovation, hold our team to the highest standard and streamline our overall processes to ensure project success for each of our clients. What You Will Do Partner with the Construction Manager to support field execution across civil, mechanical, and electrical scopes for complex utility-scale solar and energy storage projects. Assist in developing and coaching Superintendent teams by reinforcing expectations, sharing knowledge, and promoting accountability for project results. Support coordination with Safety, Quality, Environmental, Logistics, and Project Management teams to ensure alignment on project priorities and execution plans. Help monitor project performance related to safety, schedule, quality, cost, and environmental compliance through proactive planning and field engagement. Participate in weekly risk assessments and contribute to maintaining the Risk & Opportunity (R&O) log to help identify and mitigate project risks. Support environmental compliance activities, including SWPPP requirements, permitting, erosion control measures, and regulatory obligations. Assist in managing subcontractor performance by monitoring productivity, schedule adherence, safety expectations, and contract compliance. Review subcontractor change order requests, invoices, and supporting documentation while partnering with project leadership to validate scope, progress, and costs. Support development and execution of comprehensive three-week look-ahead schedules and help identify constructability, logistics, and coordination challenges before they impact project performance. Build strong relationships with customers, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders through proactive communication and reliable execution. Who You Are (Basic Qualifications) Construction experience on large-scale industrial, infrastructure, renewable energy, or utility construction projects with exposure to field execution activities. Experience coordinating work with superintendents, subcontractors, or multiple construction disciplines while supporting safety, schedule, quality, and cost objectives. Experience reviewing project schedules, budgets, contracts, change orders, or construction documentation. Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Outlook, and Word. Valid driver's license and ability to travel to project sites as required. What Will Put You Ahead Utility-scale solar, Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), substation or transmission experience. Experience supporting EPC or self-perform construction projects from mobilization through commissioning. Experience developing three-week look-ahead schedules, tracking project metrics, and supporting field productivity initiatives. Knowledge of environmental compliance requirements, including SWPPP implementation and permit management. At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy. Hiring Philosophy All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here . Who We Are As a Koch Engineered Solutions company, DEPCOM Power is a leading energy solutions partner for the utility solar and broader energy industries, providing project development support, engineering, procurement and construction, energy storage, repowering and operations and maintenance services. Our highly skilled team of conventional and renewable power industry experts work to deliver the lowest cost of energy and the highest rate of return. At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company. Our Benefits Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter. Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results. Equal Opportunities Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. review_candidates.description: DevOps Engineer Linux (m/w/d) Vollzeit (35 Std./Woche) Frühester Einstieg: zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt; Arbeitsort: Köln / Hybrid „Tagxter“ ist eine Ausgründung der Universität Köln mit Sitz in Köln-Braunsfeld. Wir entwickeln und betreiben zwei SaaS-Produkte für Industrieunternehmen und Kliniken, um Abläufe und Prozesse zu vereinfachen und zu digitalisieren: Den Site Guide (Navigation und Yard Management auf Industriegeländen) und den Shift Manager (Ausfallmanagement in Gesundheitseinrichtungen). Zu unseren Kunden zählen namhafte Firmen wie Henkel, Lufthansa, Mercedes-Benz und Bayer sowie viele Kliniken wie z. B. die Uniklinik Köln. DEINE AUFGABEN Unsere Infrastruktur läuft auf eigenen dedizierten Servern und wir wollen diese von Grund auf modernisieren. Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der unser kleines Team mit fundierten Linux-Kenntnissen verstärkt. Idealerweise kannst du uns außerdem in der Webentwicklung unterstützen. Du löst Plesk ab und baust unsere Serverlandschaft reproduzierbar mit Ansible o. ä. neu auf. Du modernisierst unsere Dev-, Test- und Staging-Umgebungen, inklusive automatischem Refresh aus der Produktion. Du stellst unsere PostgreSQL-Backups auf pgBackRest oder WAL-G mit S3-kompatiblem Storage um und ermöglichst Point-in-Time-Recovery. Du schreibst Restore-Runbooks und testest die Wiederherstellung regelmäßig. Du führst Festplattenverschlüsselung (LUKS) ein und baust Netzwerk-Monitoring mit Alarmierung auf. Du sorgst für eine sichere Konfiguration unserer Server und regelmäßige Updates aller Komponenten. Du unterstützt uns, je nach Kenntnissen, in der Webentwicklung (PHP / JS / CSS / HTML). Du übernimmst ggf. weitere technische Aufgaben nach Einarbeitung (z. B. Administration und Konfiguration von Karten und Routingservern, hier erwarten wir keine Vorkenntnisse). DEIN PROFIL Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Betrieb von Linux-Servern (Debian oder Ubuntu) Idealerweise Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung (Web/PHP) Praxis mit Ansible oder einem vergleichbaren Werkzeug für Infrastructure as Code Erfahrung mit PostgreSQL und/oder MariaDB/MySQL Solides Verständnis von Netzwerken, Firewalls und Server-Härtung Erfahrung mit regulatorischen Anforderungen von Vorteil (z. B. ISO 27001) Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und gute Englischkenntnisse Bereitschaft, in (sehr) seltenen Notfällen (z. B. kompletter Systemausfall) auch außerhalb der Arbeitszeit zu unterstützen Eine eigenverantwortliche, zuverlässige und präzise Arbeitsweise DAS BIETEN WIR Eine unbefristete Festanstellung mit 35-Stunden-Woche und 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr Ein Jahresgehalt von 60.000–80.000 € je nach Erfahrung Home-Office bis zu 4 Tage pro Woche Ein attraktives, deinen Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen entsprechendes Gehalt Deutschlandticket, steuerfreie Sachbezugskarte (SpenditCard) und Corporate Benefits Eine Stelle mit vielen Facetten und großer Entscheidungs- und Gestaltungsfreiheit (perspektivisch Primärverantwortung für den Serverbetrieb) Spannende Projekte mit namhaften Kunden aus diversen Branchen Arbeitsplatz in einem klimatisierten Büro inkl. Kaffee und Softdrinks deiner Wahl Arbeitsrechner deiner Wahl und höhenverstellbarer Schreibtisch Eine umfassende und strukturierte Einarbeitung in alle relevanten Bereiche Startup-Atmosphäre mit jeder Menge Spaß bei der Arbeit und kurzen Entscheidungswegen Schick uns bei Interesse deinen Lebenslauf, deine Gehaltsvorstellung und ein paar Zeilen zu ein oder zwei Infrastrukturprojekten, auf die du stolz bist! Сайт компании: https://rekreate.ai/ Мы ищем специалиста по международному продуктовому маркетингу, который поможет масштабировать REKREATE AI на зарубежных рынках, сформировать сильное позиционирование продукта и выстроить эффективную стратегию привлечения и удержания пользователей. На этой позиции предстоит работать в тесном взаимодействии с руководством компании, продуктовой и AI-командами, участвовать в развитии продукта и влиять на его коммерческий рост. Успешный специалист на этой позиции умеет превращать сложные AI-технологии в понятную ценность для клиентов, находить перспективные сегменты аудитории, проверять маркетинговые гипотезы и масштабировать каналы привлечения на основе данных. Обязанности Разрабатывать и реализовывать стратегию международного масштабирования продуктового маркетинга REKREATE AI на рынках США, Европы и MENA. Исследовать целевые рынки, анализировать конкурентов, пользовательские потребности и перспективные сегменты аудитории. Формировать и тестировать ценностные предложения (Value Proposition) для различных категорий пользователей: создателей контента, экспертов, малого бизнеса. Разрабатывать позиционирование продукта и ключевые маркетинговые сообщения с учетом особенностей международных рынков. Упаковывать продуктовые возможности и AI-функции в понятные коммерческие предложения, ориентированные на решение задач пользователей. Разрабатывать и оптимизировать стратегию выхода продукта на новые рынки (Go-to-Market Strategy). Тестировать и масштабировать каналы привлечения пользователей, включая Google Ads и партнерские программы. Анализировать эффективность маркетинговой воронки, выявлять причины низкой конверсии и предлагать решения для ее повышения. Работать над повышением активации, удержания пользователей и монетизации продукта совместно с продуктовой командой. Отслеживать ключевые показатели эффективности: CAC, LTV, Activation Rate, Retention, Conversion. Взаимодействовать с продуктовой и AI-командами при развитии функциональности продукта и формировании приоритетов его дальнейшего роста. Квалификационные требования Практический опыт международного продвижения и масштабирования SaaS- и/или AI-продуктов. Глубокое понимание Product Marketing, Growth Marketing и Go-to-Market Strategy. Опыт разработки продуктового позиционирования, ценностных предложений и маркетинговых стратегий. Опыт работы с цифровыми продуктами в сфере контента, социальных сетей, Creator Economy или MarTech будет преимуществом. Умение анализировать пользовательское поведение, маркетинговые воронки и эффективность каналов привлечения. Практические навыки работы с метриками CAC, LTV, Activation Rate, Retention и Conversion. Способность переводить сложные AI-функции в понятные и убедительные преимущества для пользователей. Аналитическое мышление, самостоятельность, инициативность и ориентация на измеримые результаты. Развитые навыки коммуникации и эффективного взаимодействия с продуктовыми и техническими командами. Английский язык — не ниже Advanced (обязательное требование). Высшее образование в области маркетинга, менеджмента, экономики, IT или смежных дисциплин. Дополнительное образование и сертификаты в области Digital Marketing, Product Marketing, Growth Marketing, SaaS и AI будут преимуществом. Условия Работа над международным AI-продуктом REKREATE AI. Участие в масштабировании продукта на рынках США, Европы и MENA. Взаимодействие с руководством компании, продуктовой и AI-командами. Возможность влиять на стратегию продвижения и коммерческий рост продукта. Гибкий график работы. Заработная плата — по договоренности, по результатам собеседования. Для отклика: направьте резюме с описанием опыта продвижения и масштабирования SaaS- или AI-продуктов.

review_candidates.title: Technical Manager
review_candidates.description: Technical Manager – Cutsheets Location: Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia Employment Type: Full-time Salary: Competitive A leading global technology and connectivity specialist is looking for a Technical Manager – Cutsheets to take ownership of the governance, accuracy and approval of product specification documentation used across data centre and structured cabling projects. Cutsheets are also commonly referred to as port maps or patching schedules. The role will ensure that materials, equipment and systems selected for deployment meet technical design requirements, client specifications and relevant industry standards. You will act as a key control point between Design, Procurement and Project Delivery, ensuring approved product information is technically accurate, compliant and aligned with project requirements. The successful candidate will have experience within a technical, design or engineering environment, with strong attention to detail, document control skills and the ability to manage multiple stakeholder requirements across data centre and structured cabling projects. Key Responsibilities Technical Assurance & Compliance Review and validate cutsheets against project design specifications, client requirements and applicable standards. Ensure products meet required performance, capacity and installation criteria prior to approval. Provide technical sign-off for product selection where required. Submittals & Documentation Management Own the preparation and quality of technical submittal packages. Ensure cutsheets are accurate, complete, version controlled and traceable. Ensure submissions are completed in line with project timelines. Act as the central point of contact for cutsheet-related queries. Cross-Functional Coordination Work closely with Design and Engineering teams to validate design intent. Coordinate with Procurement teams to ensure correct product ordering. Support Project Delivery teams during installation and issue resolution. Ensure alignment between approved cutsheets, Bills of Materials and installed solutions. Standardisation & Process Improvement Develop and maintain cutsheet templates and document standards. Establish naming conventions, filing structures and best-practice guidance. Drive consistency across projects and regions. Vendor & Product Management Liaise with manufacturers and suppliers to obtain current cutsheets and technical documentation. Clarify specifications and resolve technical discrepancies. Support the evaluation of alternative products and value engineering options. Risk Management & Quality Control Identify and mitigate risks associated with incorrect product selection or non-compliance. Monitor risks relating to delays in client approvals. Support issue resolution where installed products differ from approved cutsheets. Stakeholder & Client Interface Engage with clients, consultants and third-party stakeholders where required. Support technical reviews, audits and approvals. Present cutsheet documentation where necessary. What We're Looking For Essential Proven experience in a technical, design or engineering role within data centres, structured cabling, construction or MEP environments. Experience reviewing technical documentation, specifications and submittals. Experience with product data sheets, cutsheets, Bills of Materials and engineering drawings. Strong understanding of structured cabling systems, including copper and fibre. Understanding of data centre infrastructure components, installation and design standards. Ability to interpret technical specifications, performance data and compliance requirements. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Excellent document control and organisational skills. Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Good problem-solving and analytical capability. Experience using document management systems and Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and SharePoint. Familiarity with engineering documentation platforms. Desirable Experience working on hyperscale or enterprise data centre projects. Experience managing or leading a technical or documentation team. Exposure to client-specific standards, including those used by financial institutions or hyperscalers. Degree or equivalent qualification in Engineering or a relevant technical discipline. Knowledge of standards such as ISO, TIA or BICSI. Knowledge of structured cabling manufacturers such as CommScope, Panduit or Leviton. Understanding of construction submittal and approval processes. Experience with AutoCAD or similar drawing/design tools. Experience with project/document control platforms such as Aconex, Procore or BIM tools.
